        CASE 
            WHEN sd."env_handling_sensitivity"->'environment'->>'temperature' = 'High' THEN 10
            WHEN sd."env_handling_sensitivity"->'environment'->>'temperature' = 'Medium' THEN 5
            WHEN sd."env_handling_sensitivity"->'environment'->>'temperature' = 'Low' THEN 1
            ELSE NULL
        END as temp_score,
        CASE 
            WHEN sd."env_handling_sensitivity"->'environment'->>'humidity' = 'High' THEN 10
            WHEN sd."env_handling_sensitivity"->'environment'->>'humidity' = 'Medium' THEN 5
            WHEN sd."env_handling_sensitivity"->'environment'->>'humidity' = 'Low' THEN 1
            ELSE NULL
        END as humidity_score,
        CASE 
            WHEN sd."env_handling_sensitivity"->'environment'->>'light' = 'High' THEN 10
            WHEN sd."env_handling_sensitivity"->'environment'->>'light' = 'Medium' THEN 5
            WHEN sd."env_handling_sensitivity"->'environment'->>'light' = 'Low' THEN 1
            ELSE NULL
        END as light_score,
        CASE 
            WHEN sd."env_handling_sensitivity"->'environment'->>'vibration' = 'High' THEN 10
            WHEN sd."env_handling_sensitivity"->'environment'->>'vibration' = 'Medium' THEN 5
            WHEN sd."env_handling_sensitivity"->'environment'->>'vibration' = 'Low' THEN 1
            ELSE NULL
        END as vibration_score,
        CASE 
            WHEN sd."env_handling_sensitivity"->'environment'->>'pollutants' = 'High' THEN 10
            WHEN sd."env_handling_sensitivity"->'environment'->>'pollutants' = 'Medium' THEN 5
            WHEN sd."env_handling_sensitivity"->'environment'->>'pollutants' = 'Low' THEN 1
            ELSE NULL
        END as pollutants_score
    FROM "SensitivityData" sd
),
erf_calc AS (
    SELECT 
        "ART_link",
        ROUND(CAST(
            (COALESCE(temp_score, 0) + COALESCE(humidity_score, 0) + COALESCE(light_score, 0) + COALESCE(vibration_score, 0) + COALESCE(pollutants_score, 0))::numeric /
            NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN temp_score IS NOT NULL OR humidity_score IS NOT NULL OR light_score IS NOT NULL OR vibration_score IS NOT NULL OR pollutants_score IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0)
        AS numeric), 2) as erf
    FROM artifact_sensitivity
    GROUP BY "ART_link"
),
showcase_stability AS (
    SELECT 
        s."caseID",
        ROUND(CAST(
            10 - ((COALESCE(er."tempVar24", 0) + COALESCE(er."RHvar", 0)::numeric/5 + COALESCE((s."case_environment_profile"->'physical_state'->>'leak_rate_per_day')::numeric, 0)) / 3)
        AS numeric), 2) as sesr
    FROM "Showcases" s

),

        ca."case_exam" as caseID,
        esf.erf,
        ss.sesr,

    FROM "ArtifactsCore" ac
    JOIN "SensitivityData" sd ON ac.ARTregID = sd."ART_link"
    JOIN "ConditionAssessments" ca ON ac.ARTregID = ca."art_exam"
    JOIN "erf_calc" esf ON ac.ARTregID = esf."ART_link"
    JOIN "showcase_stability" ss ON ca."case_exam" = ss."caseID"
)
